relationships.subject: Senegalin-2BK
relationships.evidence_quote: The pretreatment with 10<sup>-7</sup> M Senegalin-2BK reduced the 10<sup>-6</sup> M bradykinin contraction on the bladder by over 70%.

relationships.subject: bradykinin
relationships.evidence_quote: Bradykinin induced contraction of rat bladder smooth muscle with an EC50 of 2.38 × 10−7 M.

relationships.subject: Senegalin-2BK
relationships.evidence_quote: Senegalin-2BK reflected favorable binding affinity to B2R with a binding energy of −273.333 kcal/mol.

key_findings: Senegalin-2BK, a Senegalin-2/bradykinin fusion peptide, reduced bradykinin-induced rat bladder contraction by over 70% and docks to B2R.
Senegalin-2 relaxes bladder smooth muscle (EC50 17.94 nM) and is antibacterial.
